name: Holmesglen Apprentice Support Fund
summary: Up to $2,000 towards tuition fees for Holmesglen apprentices in financial hardship.
key: Up to $2,000 per scholarship - to be used for tuition fees only.
who: Not eligible for VET Student Loans, FEE-HELP or Free TAFE, and not receiving another scholarship
how: Download and complete the Apprentice Support Fund application form from the Holmesglen page
catches: Committee meets monthly; funds subject to availability

evidence.quote: Up to $2,000 per scholarship - to be used for tuition fees only.
